title: The Silver Fox and the Lost Words
character_bible: One elegant silver-blue fox with a white muzzle and tail tip, dark indigo eyes, and one small round golden lantern on a curved handle. Never add clothing, extra lanterns, or another fox.

pages.text: At dusk, a silver fox carried a golden lantern beneath the enormous cedar trees.
pages.beat: The fox enters the blue forest with the lantern as the sole warm focal light.

pages.text: On the path, glowing letters had fallen from a frightened little book.
pages.beat: The fox discovers a small open book and a trail of dim paper letters.

pages.text: The fox listened while a young reader slowly sounded out each letter.
pages.beat: A child reads beside the fox; individual letter-shaped lights begin to wake.

pages.text: Every spoken word rose like a firefly and returned to the waiting page.
pages.beat: Warm word-shaped fireflies arc from the reader toward the open book.

pages.text: When the final word was read, the dark library bloomed with color.
pages.beat: A hidden forest library transforms from indigo darkness into luminous color.

pages.text: The fox placed the bright book where every young reader could reach it.
pages.beat: The fox presents the restored book on a low welcoming shelf for many children.
